title: Macaulay Constants and Vanishing of Cohomology
summary: Dubé introduced cone decompositions and their Macaulay constants and used them to obtain an upper bound on the degrees of the generators in a Gröbner basis of an ideal. Liang extended the theory to submodules of a free module. In this paper, Macaulay constants of any finitely generated graded module $M$ over a polynomial ring are introduced by adapting the concept of a cone decomposition to $M$.
